<awtsmoosTranslationBatch heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" batchId="multi-test-1783577472660">
  <post seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915244_theRebbe_950">
    <section verseSection="1">
      <subSection index="0" sourceHash="b248bf27a5c12b7853e8e567fc790759a593ad47c3693822c7981817d86349e9"><translation>He redeemed my soul in peace from those who beset me, for they were many with me.</translation></subSection>
      <subSection index="1" sourceHash="4d048ab285cc04139baebd83af6496523e8d267e4621dbfbbcedefcbf570ff1a"><translation>And the master of the redemption explains in his discourse beginning with the words "This"</translation></subSection>
    </section>
    <section verseSection="2">
      <subSection index="1" sourceHash="57f6787add00b007ce91bf69e2eb3ccf3a4a03ce59add546cd9d4ec25754ba30"><translation>Now, the refinement of the animal soul is through the divine soul clothing itself in the animal soul.</translation></subSection>
    </section>
    <section verseSection="3">
      <subSection index="1" sourceHash="f68869e9f7c49fd4479f10c0ff37da3d036193417d980a211376b3232ede7b4b"><translation>For the true essence of the matter of "He redeemed my soul in peace" is specifically through the revelation of the yechidah (singular essence of the soul).</translation></subSection>
    </section>
    <section verseSection="4">
      <subSection index="1" sourceHash="ae3fa4cf0012a8b8297f3358e3e88a031a72380b46e803dd31e50b0140c83667"><translation>And one must understand,</translation></subSection>
    </section>
  </post>
</awtsmoosTranslationBatch>
